package.description: Connect to Dremio or any other database that exposes an Arrow Flight SQL endpoint.

en-US.description: Connect to Dremio or any other database that exposes an Arrow Flight SQL endpoint.
en-US.longDescription:
Apache Arrow Flight SQL is a modern open source protocol, co-created by Dremio, for querying SQL-based systems such as databases, data warehouses, and data lakehouses.
Download the open source Arrow Flight SQL ODBC driver to connect to Dremio or any other database that exposes an Arrow Flight SQL endpoint.
en-US.name: Arrow Flight SQL ODBC Driver

zh-CN.description: 连接到 Dremio 或任何其他公开 Arrow Flight SQL 端点的数据库。
zh-CN.longDescription:
Apache Arrow Flight SQL 是由 Dremio 联合创建的一种现代开源协议，用于对数据库、数据仓库和数据湖屋等基于 SQL 的系统进行查询。
下载开源的 Arrow Flight SQL ODBC 驱动程序，即可连接到 Dremio 或任何其他公开 Arrow Flight SQL 端点的数据库。
